new.s: How many subjects are listed in the Eleventh Schedule of the Constitution?

new.s: How many Articles are there in Part IX of the Constitution?

new.s: Under Article 243A, the Gram Sabha exercises such powers and performs such functions as are provided by whom?
o: The Legislature of the State by law

new.angle: U0355 #12 Gram Sabha -> powers left to States (243A)

new.s: Within how many months of its dissolution must elections to constitute a new Panchayat be completed?
new.x: Article 243E requires fresh elections within six months of dissolution.

new.s: Which of the following States has a share of women among elected PRI representatives below 50 per cent?
